title: Work Experience
description: Represents a professional work experience or employment position.

position.title: Position
position.description: The job title, position, or role held by the individual.

company.title: Company
company.description: The name of the company, organization, institution, or employer.

companyUrl.title: Company URL
companyUrl.description: A URI linking to the website of the company or employer. Null indicates that no URL is available.

location.title: Location
location.description: The city, region, country, or other location associated with the work experience.

type.title: Work Arrangement
type.description: The work arrangement for the position.

startDate.title: Start Date
startDate.description: The year or month in which the work experience began, using YYYY or YYYY-MM format.

startLabel.title: Start Date Label
startLabel.description: The human-readable label used to display the work experience start date.

endDate.title: End Date
endDate.description: The year or month in which the work experience ended, using YYYY or YYYY-MM format. Null indicates that the position is ongoing.

endLabel.title: End Date Label
endLabel.description: The human-readable label used to display the work experience end date. Null indicates that the position is ongoing.

current.title: Current Position
current.description: Indicates whether the individual currently holds this position.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: A brief overview of the responsibilities, contributions, or overall scope of the work experience.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.description: A list of notable achievements, results, contributions, or accomplishments from the work experience.

items.description: A notable achievement, result, contribution, or accomplishment.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: A list of skills, technologies, tools, or areas of expertise used in the work experience.

items.description: A skill, technology, tool, or area of expertise.
